title: 5dot: A Mobile App That Checks If Audio, Video or Lip-Sync Is AI-Generated
headline: Know what's real: check any clip in minutes
summary: Upload a file or paste a link from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook or X, and get a clear verdict on whether the voice, the video and the lip-sync are real.
problem: AI-generated and edited media spreads fast, and ordinary people have no simple way to check whether a clip is genuine.
solution: 5dot is a mobile app backed by deep-learning detection. Users upload a video or audio file, or paste a link, and get one verdict built from three separate checks: AI voice, AI-generated video and lip-sync mismatch. Each check shows a score against its threshold and a per-segment chart over time, and the result can be exported as a PDF.
highlights: Three signals, one verdict: AI voice, AI video and lip-sync
Upload a file or paste a link from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook or X
Plain-language result with technical details one tap away
Score over time for every segment of the clip
PDF export and a "Wrong?" button to report bad results
Sign in with Google or email, with a free plan and usage tracking

results.label: Anyone can check a suspicious clip from their phone
A clear verdict, with the evidence behind it, instead of a bare score
